exposure: Third-trimester ultrasonography (USG) findings (placental thickness, estimated fetal weight (EFW), amniotic fluid index (AFI), placental grading)
outcome: Placental histopathological changes (syncytial knots, chorangiosis, fibrinoid necrosis, intervillous thrombosis)
cohort: The study included 85 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) after 28 weeks of gestation, recruited from a tertiary care center in Chennai.
finding: Third-trimester USG findings, particularly increased placental thickness and estimated fetal weight, significantly correlate with specific histopathological changes in the placentas of women with GDM.
cross-section timing: Third-trimester (most USG at 31-32 weeks) and immediately after delivery for placental collection.
gest_age: Women diagnosed with GDM after 28 weeks; most USG at 31-32 weeks; term deliveries (37-38 weeks) in 90.6% of cases.
